explicit_gaps.title: Room for improvement in synthetic clinical notes generation
explicit_gaps.description: The generated synthetic clinical notes, while useful, still leave ample room for future improvements.

explicit_gaps.title: Performance/Fairness trade-off in ensemble methods
explicit_gaps.description: Improving fairness (via EO post-processing) usually results in a degradation of performance (AUC), and ensemble performance improvements do not directly translate to fairness improvements.

explicit_gaps.title: Limited scope of sentence generation approach
explicit_gaps.description: The core approach (rearranging tokens based on bigrams) remained the same across all events, despite material adaptation.

explicit_gaps.title: Model size/resource intensity for deployment
explicit_gaps.description: The lightweight clinical transformers are still heavy in size and number of parameters, making them unsuitable for devices with limited memory and processing capacity.

explicit_gaps.title: Requirement for extensive domain knowledge and time waste
explicit_gaps.description: The disease detection job requires extensive botanical knowledge and results in much wasted time.

explicit_gaps.title: Implied limitations in clinical study data
explicit_gaps.description: Most clinical studies have limitations regarding long-term cognitive trajectory forecasting.

explicit_gaps.title: Impact of lower-quality MRI data on subtype reproducibility
explicit_gaps.description: The use of 'lower-quality' MRI data was identified as a limitation in assessing data-driven dementia subtypes.

explicit_gaps.title: Resource intensity and subjectivity of manual analysis
explicit_gaps.description: Manual analysis of safety occurrence reports is resource-intensive, limited by human capacity, subjectivity, and potential for oversight.

explicit_gaps.title: Lack of established reporting guidelines for computational benchmarks
explicit_gaps.description: No established reporting guideline covers non-interventional computational benchmarks of clinical LLM behavior.
